up: Return all activity rows for the human GnRH receptor (ChEMBL ID: CHEMBL1855) where the standard_type is 'IC50' and the standard_units is 'nM'. The result must include the ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI (prefer PubMed if both exist), assay description, target preferred name, and target organism. Only include rows where a canonical SMILES and a PubMed ID or DOI are present.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description,
  td.pref_name,
  td.organism
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1855'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
  AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL);
